test_title: PYST 02: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 04 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seated in a straight line facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). V is seated immediately to the right of Q and immediately to the left of R. P is seated immediately to the right of R and immediately to the left of S. U is seated second to the right of S. U is seated at one of the extreme ends of the line. Who is sitting between S and U?
solution: Given, Seven people P, Q. R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight line facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order). V is sitting to the immediate right of Q and the immediate left of R.
